description: Wrapping row of selectable chips for budget frequency. Same visual language as add-transaction FrequencyChips, with the extra '1st & 15th' option and no due-day reveal.

onChange.description: (next) => void — also updates the AmountHero frequency echo

behavior: Five chips wrap to two rows on a 390pt screen (flexWrap). Selecting a value updates the AmountHero frequency-echo caption ('per month', 'every 2 weeks', etc.). Unlike add-transaction, no chip reveals an extra field (there is no due-day here). Display labels are friendlier than raw values ('1st & 15th' for '1st-15th').

accessibility.colorIndependent: Selection conveyed by checked state + weight, not tint alone
